verdict.rationale: Raygun's evidence covers general data privacy/security features (removing sensitive data, IP address suppression) and AI-powered error resolution using OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, but there is no statement anywhere about whether customer data is used to train AI models or any opt-out/control mechanism for AI training usage. This is a plausible and important axis for a product that integrates third-party LLMs, but no evidence addresses it.
